page.layout: Two parallel blocks of text: on the left a column of Hebrew text (four stanza-like groups of Hebrew lines); on the right a column of Latin text with marginal Hebrew-free commentary in the same column. No page number, no running head, no catchword, no signature visible. Right-side Latin column runs top to bottom; the Hebrew column on the left is a separate column of Hebrew lines with its own reading order. Note: a stamp "Google" at lower right is a digitiser mark and is omitted.

main_text.p: רוח זכרים עולות Eder, ut & in æquali
נקיבות זבחי שלמי spatio versus omnes
רבי יהודה אומר mundi plagas repe-
הראוי לפסחים פסחים verò sacrificia paci-
קודם לרגל שלשים fica. R. Iehuda in-
[masculos] reperiatur aliquis, qui aptus sit ad Pascha, Pascha fit, [modo reperiatur] triginta diebus ante Festum.

ה בראשונה היו ממשכנין את מוצאיה עד שהוא מביא נסכיה חזרו להיות מניחין אותה ובורחין התקינו בית דין שיהו נסכיה באין משל ציבור : V. Ab initio op-pignorabant eum, qui pecus reperie-rat, donec afferret libamina eius. Sed inceperunt homines illa pecora relinque-re, & fugere, consti-tuit itaque Syne-drium ut libamina [sumptus] Ecclesiæ fierent.
ו אמר רבי שמעון שבעה דברי התקינו בית דין וזה אחד VI. Dixit R. Si-meon, septem de-creta fecit Syne-drium; & hoc unum

page.notes: Hebrew column is set in Hebrew type on the left; its lines are transcribed as printed where legible, and the Latin column on the right carries no marginal notes. Marginal bracketed words [masculos], [modo reperiatur], [sumptus] are printed in italic in the text. Some Hebrew words and the ends of lines are damaged by ink stains and may be imprecise. Page is printed with heavy staining; the Hebrew line-end words are approximate.
